parameters.content: WF00 v-next - Lead Finder Orchestrator (F22/F27/F28/F31/F34 assembly). Manual start -> business context -> SF1 profile (or resume an existing profile id) -> run record -> APPROVAL GATE (profile status must be approved in the database) -> SF2 Maps discovery -> SF4 dedupe -> SF7 scoring -> SF5 research -> SF3 v2 people finder (open route, 2 searches) -> SF9 timing re-score -> SF8 approval view sync -> run closed. v8: coverage gate after the approval gate (rubric deterministic coverage must be >= 35/70, from rubric.coverage or recomputed with the SF7 classifier); SF5 v2 and SF3 v3 return empty-pick summaries so a run always closes. Error workflow ERR marks stuck runs failed. Drafts only; nothing is ever sent.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO runs (search_profile_id, profile_version, status, notes) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, 'started', 'WF00 orchestrated run') RETURNING id, search_profile_id, profile_version
UPDATE runs SET config_snapshot = $2::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id
SELECT status, profile, rubric FROM search_profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE search_profile_id = $1::uuid) AS discovered, (SELECT count(*) FROM scores WHERE search_profile_id = $1::uuid AND profile_version = $2) AS scored, (SELECT count(*) FROM scores s WHERE s.search_profile_id = $1::uuid AND s.profile_version = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.fit_components) c WHERE (c->>'awarded')::numeric > 0)) AS det_matched
UPDATE runs SET status = 'done', finished_at = now(), notes = $2 WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Glue - To SF7').item.json.run_id, 'SF2 found ' + $('Glue - To SF4').item.json.discovered + '; SF4 inserted ' + $('Glue - To SF7').item.json.dedupe.inserted + ' (dup ' + $('Glue - To SF7').item.json.dedupe.duplicates + ', suppressed ' + $('Glue - To SF7').item.json.dedupe.suppressed + '); SF7 scored ' + $('SF7 v-next - Score Leads').item.json.scored + '; SF5 researched ' + $('SF5 v-next - Research Leads').item.json.researched + ' ; SF3 people searched ' + $('SF3 v-next - Find People').item.json.companies_processed + ' companies, saved ' + $('SF3 v-next - Find People').item.json.people_saved + ' people; SF9 timing rescored ' + $('SF9 v-next - Timing Re-Score').item.json.rescored + ' (' + $('SF9 v-next - Timing Re-Score').item.json.with_timing + ' with timing); SF8 approval view published ' + $('SF8 v-next - Approval View Sync').item.json.published + ' rows' ] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE runs SET status = 'insufficient_coverage', finished_at = now(), notes = 'Stopped at the F27 post-discovery coverage gate - too few discovered companies match the rubric deterministically. See the Gmail draft alert for the ratio.' WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Post-discovery coverage below the configured minimum (or nothing discovered). Run closed before research spend; see the Gmail draft alert.

parameters.query: UPDATE runs SET status = 'blocked_coverage', notes = 'Stopped at the coverage gate - rubric deterministic coverage below 35/70. Regenerate the profile with SF1 (deterministic scoring contract), approve the new version, then re-run.' WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Rubric deterministic coverage is below the 35/70 floor. Regenerate the profile with SF1 so the rubric follows the deterministic scoring contract, approve the new version, then re-run.

parameters.query: UPDATE runs SET status = 'insufficient_coverage', finished_at = now(), notes = 'Stopped at the F27 preflight gate - profile max_achievable is 0: no deterministic or judge-scored path to any band. Rework the rubric or the discovery source.' WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Profile max_achievable is 0 - nothing in this rubric can be scored. Rework the profile before spending on discovery.

parameters.query: UPDATE runs SET status = 'awaiting_profile_approval', notes = 'Stopped at the approval gate - profile is still draft' WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, status

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Profile is still draft. Approve it in the database (status = approved), then re-run WF00 with existing_profile_id set to this profile.
